001package com.streamConverter.analysis;
002
003import java.io.IOException;
004import java.nio.file.Files;
005import java.nio.file.Path;
006import java.nio.file.Paths;
007import java.util.*;
008import java.util.stream.Collectors;
009import javax.xml.parsers.DocumentBuilder;
010import javax.xml.parsers.DocumentBuilderFactory;
011import org.slf4j.Logger;
012import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
013import org.w3c.dom.Document;
014import org.w3c.dom.Element;
015import org.w3c.dom.NodeList;
016
017/**
018 * PMD XMLレポートをAI可読形式に変換するユーティリティクラス
019 *
020 * <p>PMDの生XMLレポートは構造化されているが冗長で、AI解析には適していない。 このクラスは以下の形式に変換する:
021 *
022 * <ul>
023 *   <li>Markdown要約レポート - AI可読性の高いサマリー
024 *   <li>CSVレポート - スプレッドシート分析用
025 *   <li>JSON構造化レポート - プログラム解析用
026 * </ul>
027 */
028public class PmdReportConverter {
029  private static final Logger LOG = LoggerFactory.getLogger(PmdReportConverter.class);
030  /** Creates a new converter. */
031  public PmdReportConverter() {}
032
033  /**
034   * CLI entry point for converting a PMD XML report.
035   *
036   * @param args arguments where args[0] is the XML file and args[1] is the optional output
037   *     directory
038   * @throws Exception if conversion fails
039   */
040  public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
041    if (args.length < 1) {
042      if (LOG.isErrorEnabled()) {
043        LOG.error("Usage: PmdReportConverter <pmd-xml-file> [output-dir]");
044      }
045      System.exit(1);
046    }
047
048    String xmlFile = args[0];
049    String outputDir = args.length > 1 ? args[1] : "build/reports/pmd/converted";
050
051    PmdReportConverter converter = new PmdReportConverter();
052    converter.convertReport(xmlFile, outputDir);
053  }
054
055  /**
056   * Converts the given PMD XML report into multiple formats.
057   *
058   * @param xmlFilePath path to the PMD XML file
059   * @param outputDir directory where converted reports will be written
060   * @throws Exception if processing fails
061   */
062  public void convertReport(String xmlFilePath, String outputDir) throws Exception {
063    Path xmlPath = Paths.get(xmlFilePath);
064    Path outputPath = Paths.get(outputDir);
065    Files.createDirectories(outputPath);
066
067    // XML解析
068    List<PmdViolation> violations = parseXmlReport(xmlPath);
069
070    // 各形式で出力
071    generateMarkdownReport(violations, outputPath.resolve("pmd-summary.md"));
072    generateCsvReport(violations, outputPath.resolve("pmd-violations.csv"));
073    generateJsonReport(violations, outputPath.resolve("pmd-report.json"));
074
075    if (LOG.isInfoEnabled()) {
076      LOG.info("✅ PMD報告書変換完了:");
077    }
078    if (LOG.isInfoEnabled()) {
079      LOG.info("   📄 Markdown: {}", outputPath.resolve("pmd-summary.md"));
080    }
081    if (LOG.isInfoEnabled()) {
082      LOG.info("   📊 CSV: {}", outputPath.resolve("pmd-violations.csv"));
083    }
084    if (LOG.isInfoEnabled()) {
085      LOG.info("   🔗 JSON: {}", outputPath.resolve("pmd-report.json"));
086    }
087  }
088
089  private List<PmdViolation> parseXmlReport(Path xmlPath) throws Exception {
090    DocumentBuilder builder = DocumentBuilderFactory.newInstance().newDocumentBuilder();
091    Document doc = builder.parse(xmlPath.toFile());
092
093    NodeList fileNodes = doc.getElementsByTagName("file");
094    List<PmdViolation> violations = new ArrayList<>();
095
096    for (int i = 0; i < fileNodes.getLength(); i++) {
097      Element fileElement = (Element) fileNodes.item(i);
098      String fileName = fileElement.getAttribute("name");
099
100      NodeList violationNodes = fileElement.getElementsByTagName("violation");
101      for (int j = 0; j < violationNodes.getLength(); j++) {
102        Element violationElement = (Element) violationNodes.item(j);
103
104        PmdViolation violation =
105            new PmdViolation(
106                extractRelativePath(fileName),
107                Integer.parseInt(violationElement.getAttribute("beginline")),
108                violationElement.getAttribute("rule"),
109                violationElement.getAttribute("ruleset"),
110                Integer.parseInt(violationElement.getAttribute("priority")),
111                violationElement.getTextContent().trim(),
112                violationElement.getAttribute("class"),
113                violationElement.getAttribute("method"),
114                violationElement.getAttribute("variable"));
115        violations.add(violation);
116      }
117    }
118
119    return violations;
120  }
121
122  private String extractRelativePath(String fullPath) {
123    // StreamConverterプロジェクト内の相対パスを抽出
124    int index = fullPath.indexOf("streamconverter-");
125    return index != -1 ? fullPath.substring(index) : fullPath;
126  }
127
128  private void generateMarkdownReport(List<PmdViolation> violations, Path outputPath)
129      throws IOException {
130    StringBuilder md = new StringBuilder();
131
132    md.append("# PMD Code Quality Analysis Report\n\n");
133    md.append("**Generated**: ").append(new Date()).append("\n");
134    md.append("**Total Violations**: ").append(violations.size()).append("\n\n");
135
136    // 違反数上位のルール
137    Map<String, Long> ruleStats =
138        violations.stream()
139            .collect(Collectors.groupingBy(PmdViolation::rule, Collectors.counting()));
140
141    md.append("## 🎯 Top Code Smell Rules\n\n");
142    md.append("| Rank | Rule | Count | Category |\n");
143    md.append("|------|------|-------|----------|\n");
144
145    ruleStats.entrySet().stream()
146        .sorted(Map.Entry.<String, Long>comparingByValue().reversed())
147        .limit(20)
148        .forEach(
149            entry -> {
150              String category =
151                  violations.stream()
152                      .filter(v -> v.rule().equals(entry.getKey()))
153                      .findFirst()
154                      .map(PmdViolation::ruleset)
155                      .orElse("Unknown");
156              md.append(
157                  String.format(
158                      "| | %s | %d | %s |\n", entry.getKey(), entry.getValue(), category));
159            });
160
161    // ファイル別統計
162    Map<String, Long> fileStats =
163        violations.stream()
164            .collect(Collectors.groupingBy(PmdViolation::file, Collectors.counting()));
165
166    md.append("\n## 📁 Files with Most Issues\n\n");
167    md.append("| File | Violations |\n");
168    md.append("|------|------------|\n");
169
170    fileStats.entrySet().stream()
171        .sorted(Map.Entry.<String, Long>comparingByValue().reversed())
172        .limit(15)
173        .forEach(
174            entry -> {
175              md.append(
176                  String.format(
177                      "| %s | %d |\n",
178                      entry.getKey().replaceAll(".*/(\\w+\\.java)", "$1"), entry.getValue()));
179            });
180
181    // 優先度別統計
182    Map<Integer, Long> priorityStats =
183        violations.stream()
184            .collect(Collectors.groupingBy(PmdViolation::priority, Collectors.counting()));
185
186    md.append("\n## ⚡ Priority Distribution\n\n");
187    md.append("| Priority | Count | Description |\n");
188    md.append("|----------|-------|-------------|\n");
189    priorityStats.entrySet().stream()
190        .sorted(Map.Entry.comparingByKey())
191        .forEach(
192            entry -> {
193              String desc =
194                  switch (entry.getKey()) {
195                    case 1 -> "🔴 High - Critical issues";
196                    case 2 -> "🟡 Medium - Important issues";
197                    case 3 -> "🟢 Low - Minor issues";
198                    case 4 -> "ℹ️ Info - Informational";
199                    default -> "❓ Unknown";
200                  };
201              md.append(
202                  String.format("| %d | %d | %s |\n", entry.getKey(), entry.getValue(), desc));
203            });
204
205    Files.writeString(outputPath, md.toString());
206  }
207
208  private void generateCsvReport(List<PmdViolation> violations, Path outputPath)
209      throws IOException {
210    StringBuilder csv = new StringBuilder();
211    csv.append("File,Line,Rule,Category,Priority,Description,Class,Method,Variable\n");
212
213    violations.forEach(
214        v -> {
215          csv.append(
216              String.format(
217                  "\"%s\",%d,\"%s\",\"%s\",%d,\"%s\",\"%s\",\"%s\",\"%s\"\n",
218                  v.file(),
219                  v.line(),
220                  v.rule(),
221                  v.ruleset(),
222                  v.priority(),
223                  v.description().replace("\"", "\"\""),
224                  v.className(),
225                  v.method(),
226                  v.variable()));
227        });
228
229    Files.writeString(outputPath, csv.toString());
230  }
231
232  private void generateJsonReport(List<PmdViolation> violations, Path outputPath)
233      throws IOException {
234    StringBuilder json = new StringBuilder();
235    json.append("{\n");
236    json.append("  \"summary\": {\n");
237    json.append("    \"totalViolations\": ").append(violations.size()).append(",\n");
238    json.append("    \"generatedAt\": \"").append(new Date()).append("\"\n");
239    json.append("  },\n");
240    json.append("  \"violations\": [\n");
241
242    for (int i = 0; i < violations.size(); i++) {
243      PmdViolation v = violations.get(i);
244      json.append("    {\n");
245      json.append("      \"file\": \"").append(v.file()).append("\",\n");
246      json.append("      \"line\": ").append(v.line()).append(",\n");
247      json.append("      \"rule\": \"").append(v.rule()).append("\",\n");
248      json.append("      \"category\": \"").append(v.ruleset()).append("\",\n");
249      json.append("      \"priority\": ").append(v.priority()).append(",\n");
250      json.append("      \"description\": \"")
251          .append(v.description().replace("\"", "\\\""))
252          .append("\",\n");
253      json.append("      \"class\": \"").append(v.className()).append("\",\n");
254      json.append("      \"method\": \"").append(v.method()).append("\",\n");
255      json.append("      \"variable\": \"").append(v.variable()).append("\"\n");
256      json.append("    }").append(i < violations.size() - 1 ? "," : "").append("\n");
257    }
258
259    json.append("  ]\n");
260    json.append("}\n");
261
262    Files.writeString(outputPath, json.toString());
263  }
264
265  /**
266   * PMD違反情報を表すレコードクラス
267   *
268   * @param file ファイルパス
269   * @param line 行番号
270   * @param rule 違反ルール
271   * @param ruleset ルールセット
272   * @param priority 優先度
273   * @param description 説明
274   * @param className クラス名
275   * @param method メソッド名
276   * @param variable 変数名
277   */
278  public record PmdViolation(
279      String file,
280      int line,
281      String rule,
282      String ruleset,
283      int priority,
284      String description,
285      String className,
286      String method,
287      String variable) {}
288}
